The sdCup is a premier weekend tournament featuring a hefty prize pool and top class talent. It encourages even pings allowing for the entire world to participate online in epic weekend bouts between the best players out there.

The second installment of sdCup is not like the first at all. It's all about bloodfest survival on '''[[barrel]]''' aka ''Da Barrello''! The event kicked off the 2 February 2021.

===How to compete===
# Get on a server close to you with the updated version of the map on it.
# Type <mark>/barrel</mark> in the console, followed by /votecoop to enable the mode "bloodfest". Make sure <mark>match_auto_record</mark> is off.
# Type <mark>/record <your nickname></mark>, for example /record Milton.
# Type <mark>/ready</mark>
# Frag and survive for 10 minutes. Once you reach the 10 minute mark, you can either die or just type <mark>/stop</mark> to stop the recording. Kills after the 10 minute mark will not be counted. 
# If you die earlier than you wanted and want to try again, type <mark>/stop</mark> to stop the recording, then start recording again - rinse and repeat till you're happy.
# Once you believe you have the tournament winning attempt, get on [http://discord.quake.world discord], find the name "Andeh/suddendeathTV" and '''PM the demo'''. That's it!

===Clients and rulesets:===

All clients are allowed for this tournament, obviously without any cheats allowed.

NOTE: If you are experiencing crashes, consider updating to the latest EzQuake alpha or use the command <mark>cl_pext_256packetentities 0</mark> which should limit the amount of crashes to a minimum.

===Reporting===

On the [http://discord.quake.world QuakeWorld Discord], '''PM the demo''' to "Andeh/suddendeathTV". 

===Streaming===

[https://www.twitch.tv/suddendeathTV suddendeathTV] will host a live stream after the deadline (Sunday 21st) going through demos and results. 

===Demos===
At the end of the tournament, a demo pack of all the top 10 runs will be available for all to download and watch.
